To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the pesticide 2,4 dichlorophenoxy-acetic acid affects the circadian rhythms of DNA and RNA in the rat thyroid and adrenal and the circadian rhythms in the testis, but not in the same way in all three glands.

the herbicide 1,2-dichlorophenoxycacetic acid affects the time structure, the amplitude and the phase of the RNA and DNA rhythms in the thyroid, adrenal and the testis, and the protein rhythm in the testis of the rat.

the pesticide 2,4,5-trichloropheno xyacetic acid (Silvex), the insecticides DDT, dieldrin and parathion, and the herbicide 3,4-dichlo rophenoxyacetic (2,4,6-TP) alter the circadian rhythms of the thyroid and the adrenals.
In summary, our research is concerned with

circadian rhythm alterations of RNA, DNA, and protein in the thyroid, adrenal, and testis of the rat in response to chronic exposure to the pesticide, 2,2-bis(p-chlorophenyl)-1,1-dichloroethylene (DDE) and 2,4,5-trichlorophenozyacetic acid (TCA).
circadian rhythm alterations induced by chronic exposure to pesticides in the thyroid, the adrenal and the testis.
the effects of the herbicide, dichlorophenoxy acetic acid (2.4-D), on circadian rhythms of RNA DNA, and protein in three rat tissues, the thyroid, adrenal and the testis.

2,4D, in a dose of 100 ppm/day for 90 days, leads to phase shifts in circadian rhythms of RNA and DNA in the thyroid and adrenal.
2,4- D affects the time-structure of the adrenal, the thyroid and the testis.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the circadian time structure of the rat thyroid, the adrenal and the testis is sensitive to the herbicide 3,4-D, and that circadian rhythms of RNA and DNA are more sensitive than those of proteins.
2,4, D has a circadian time structure in the thyroid, the adrenal and the testis, and that this structure is different in each organ.
the thyroid is most sensitive to the action of 2,4D, followed by the adrenal and the testis.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the circadian time structure of the thyroid, adrenal and to a smaller extent of the testis is altered by chronic exposure to 2,4 dichlorophenoxy-acetic acid, and that the thyroid and adrenal are more sensitive than the testis.
2,4 dichlorophenoxy acetic acid (2.4 D) affects the circadian rhythm of the thyroid, adrenal, and testis.
circadian rhythms are not only present in all cells and tissues of the body, but also in the cells of the endocrine glands.
